title: Free JuCo Soccer: Pierce vs. Santa Barbara
description: Western State Conference soccer at its best. Pierce hosts Santa Barbara — completely free to attend. Real competition, great atmosphere, zero ticket cost.

title: Sports at Mt. SAC: Mt. SAC vs. Pacific Grove GL - Pacific Grove, CA
description: At Mt. SAC's world-class Hilmer Lodge Stadium, Mt. SAC hosts Pacific Grove GL - Pacific Grove, CA for sports. The setting alone makes this worth the trip — and admission is free.

title: Free JuCo Basketball: Rio Hondo vs. Compton
description: Skip the $200 pro tickets and catch genuine basketball at Rio Hondo College Athletic Complex. Rio Hondo vs. Compton is free and delivers real energy.

title: Chargers vs. Denver Broncos
description: SoFi Stadium plays host as the Chargers take on the Denver Broncos this Sunday. Circle this one on the calendar.

title: Lakers vs. Sacramento Kings
description: The Sacramento Kings come to town for a Friday clash at Crypto.com Arena. The Lakers are looking to put on a show for the home crowd.

title: Big Ten Heavyweights: USC vs. Michigan Wolverines
description: Big Ten Heavyweights — need we say more? Galen Center will be rocking when the Michigan Wolverines roll in. Don't miss this one.
